scope.reference_commit_source: GitHub page latest commit shown on 2026-09-20

direct_runtime.reason: awesome-jev is a curated reference list, not a runnable Jev implementation. The documented TypeSafe SDK/API path requires hosted access and an API key; no credentials or unapproved external service were used. No local Jev weights were found or downloaded.
blocked_measurements: Jev accuracy on the local fixture
Jev calibration metrics on the local fixture
Jev latency/resource use in this environment
per-capability apples-to-apples quality against local labels

adapter.mapping: local catalog questions map naturally to Jev Choice, Score, and Noul primitives, but no Jev response can be produced without hosted credentials or an approved gateway

local_measurements.interpretation: Offline fixture rows validate local response-shape coverage only; they are not model predictions.

local_learned_quality.calibration_note: Held-out local DistilBERT evaluation; calibration is post-hoc and does not estimate Jev quality.

output_types.finding: Interface-level alignment; Jev documents calibrated probabilities/confidence, while local taxonomy defines typed advisory questions and keeps execution ownership in deterministic code.

question_coverage.jev: General typed questions; documented use cases include classify, route, score, detect, rank, extract, verify, and gate
question_coverage.finding: Not an apples-to-apples count: Jev is a general model primitive and local names are an application catalog.

calibration.jev: Reference attributes calibrated probabilities to RLCD; no independently reproduced calibration result was run here
calibration.local: ECE/Brier/NLL recorded in reports/final-capabilities.json on 53 held-out examples per capability
calibration.finding: Claims are not directly comparable without the same labeled cases and scoring protocol.

ownership_and_fail_open.jev: Questions return values for application code; composition/thresholds/side effects belong to code
ownership_and_fail_open.local: Deterministic guards own precedence and execution; advisory inference cannot authorize and backend outage is an error
ownership_and_fail_open.finding: Local policy is explicit and tested; Jev reference describes the same separation at the application-pattern level.

jev.provenance: vendor-reported comparison reproduced in awesome-jev README; not measured here

local.provenance: offline backend performs no inference and therefore has no comparable request latency

per_capability_quality.local: Available in reports/final-capabilities.json; values are local learned-model metrics
per_capability_quality.finding: No Jev per-capability labels or runtime outputs were available.
